newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to sell naphtha for Mar 24-25.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to sell naphtha for Mar 24-25.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to sell 110,000-125,000 barrels of light naphtha for March 24-25 lifting, a CPC source said on Wednesday.
The cargo is on a free-on-board (fob) basis from Colombo.
The tender closes on March 18 and bids will be valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC bought 25,000 tonnes of naphtha at 73 cents per barrel below Singapore spot quotes, for January 20-21 lifting, fob Colombo.
The cargo was sold to Swiss trader Glencore.
